about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Velar P250 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Velar P250 uses the Ingenium AJ200P — a 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder petrol engine. It was introduced with the Velar's L560 generation in 2017 and remains in production. The AJ200P is a member of Jaguar Land Rover's Ingenium family, a modular engine architecture designed for flexibility across both petrol and diesel applications. In the Velar range, the P250 sits as the entry-level petrol option, offering a balance of performance and efficiency within a lighter engine package than the larger six-cylinder units higher up the range.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ingenium AJ200P engines for every Range Rover Velar P250 on the road.

compatibility.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Velar P250 ENGINE
compatibility.intro: The Velar P250 uses a single engine family across its entire production run — the Ingenium AJ200P. However, as with any modern engine, there can be running changes, ECU calibration variations, and ancillary differences between early and later builds. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (Ingenium AJ200P) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
